title: steplock checklist config
description: Configuration for a steplock checklist gate (config.toml).

on_event.description: polyhook event type that triggers this checklist.

on_tool.description: Normalized polyhook tool name to match (e.g. 'bash', 'write_file').

match_input.description: Optional CEL expression evaluated against the hook event. Omit to match all invocations of on_event + on_tool. Available variables: input.<key>, output.<key>, event.tool, event.event, event.caller.

reset.description: When to reset checklist progress. Defaults to 'session'.

allow_preview_request.description: Let the agent run preview.sh to see all checklist items before starting. Defaults to false.
